pages.title: Tectonic Press
pages.text: A multi-anvil press over a firebox: it squeezes rock to the pressures of the deep mantle and bakes it to match. What crystallises depends on where on the phase diagram you hold it.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the anvil pressure and the furnace temperature. Below the graphite-diamond line carbon stays graphite; above it, with $(item)Iron-Nickel$() as the solvent catalyst beside the press, it becomes diamond. Peridotite turns to $(item)Ringwoodite$() above 17.5 GPa and to $(item)Bridgmanite$() above the post-spinel line near 23 GPa. Basalt becomes $(item)Metamorphic Schist$() at a few kilobars.

pages.name: Tectonic Press
pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().

$(thing)Machine data$(): a multiblock (16 item and 16 fluid inputs, 4 and 4 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Accretion Disk Fragment, Boron Control Rod, Bridgmanite, Brown Dwarf Core, Garnet, Graphite Moderator, Metamorphic Schist, Planetary Core Sample, Ringwoodite, White Dwarf Core.
A high-pressure form of olivine from 520 km down. Its crystals hold water: there may be more of it in the mantle than in every ocean.$(br2)Made in $(item)Spectrograph$().
The most abundant mineral on Earth - and almost never seen, because it only exists under the pressure of the lower mantle.$(br2)Made in $(item)Tectonic Press$().
Basalt pressed and baked until its minerals regrew as flat, glittering mica - with the odd red garnet among them.$(br2)Made in $(item)Tectonic Press$().
